instruction: Chad has asked me for my weekly workout plan over email. I have drafted a reply to it. Please export my workout plan note from Simple Note to a text file, attach it to the draft, and send the email.
notes: Four apps: supervisor (passwords, completion), simple_note (find + read the workout plan note), file_system (write the note content to a new text file), gmail (locate Chad's thread and the existing reply draft, upload the file as attachment, send the draft). The draft is identified via show_inbox_threads(query) -> show_thread (which lists drafts in the thread); the evaluation requires that the sent email replies to Chad's email in that thread, carries exactly one attachment whose content equals the note content, and that the existing draft is consumed (not a new draft/email). Static init facts (note-matches-query, note-content, thread-matches-query, draft-in-thread) encode what lookups will reveal; known-id/found-content/file-created predicates gate downstream calls. upload must precede send (precondition (not (sent ?d))). supervisor-complete-task takes the draft and content as task-record parameters (no answer) and its precondition mirrors the goal. Tokens/passwords/usernames are tied to apps with static token-for/password-for/username-for facts so the planner binds the right credential objects. The file path value is a free choice; only the file content matters for evaluation. attachment_file_paths is passed as a one-element list containing the created file path.
